summary.text: GO: expressed (9.3 TPM in Small_Intestine_Terminal_Ileum, a disease tissue for this contrast), dysregulated in the study (logFC 3.1, adjusted p 2.2e-22), and a mouse phenotype on record (phenotyped, 6 abnormal terms). Hypothesis: inhibition, because the gene is up-regulated in Crohn's disease versus non-inflammatory-bowel-disease controls, logFC 3.1, adjusted p 2.2e-22. Mouse phenotypes include abnormal gallbladder physiology, abnormal intestinal lipid absorption, decreased digestive secretion, decreased intestinal cholesterol absorption, gallstones and decreased tumour growth/size; expression is 9.3 TPM in Small_Intestine_Terminal_Ileum against a median of 6.992 TPM across 54 tissues. The pipeline holds 12 agents across 22 distinct trials, furthest TECEMOTIDE (a protein) at Phase 3, with no active trials and 1 agent having a trial stopped for cause; development level: potent small molecules exist, 16 ChEMBL mechanisms, and 40,606 PubTator3 records. No data: chemical probe.
